data.locator: Patient reassessment and Patient POC sections; 42 CFR 494.80 and 494.90 references
data.source_setting: Medicare-certified U.S. ESRD dialysis facilities; regulatory guidance, not an inpatient hospital cohort.
data.source_period: CMS web guidance accessed 2026-10-10; page revision date not stated in the consulted sections.
value: written individualized plan of care with measurable outcomes/timelines
coordinate dialysis dose/volume, nutrition, mineral metabolism, anemia and vascular-access management
revise plan when needs or condition change
data.source_evidence_basis: CMS describes assessment/reassessment, an interdisciplinary team, a written individualized plan, expected outcomes and timelines, and specified care domains.
data.limitations: Source concerns ESRD facilities and longitudinal program requirements, not acute inpatient dialysis activation, transport, machine setup, treatment duration, or hospital staffing.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent inpatient dialysis as a specialty-service request and coordination dependency with nephrology/nursing and a separate treatment event; use this page only for the interdisciplinary planning context, not acute-session timing.
